candidate_scope.loader: one validation call; old validation retained
candidate_scope.evaluate: separate body_transfer_fraction=max(original transfer_fraction,current functional carry/settle floor); motion_weight uses body fraction only
candidate_scope.geometry_bounds_origin: Existing current task engineering values: non-RR AIR gap >= 0.015 m, near-front [-0.40,0.15] m or within_top_xy, TOP gap [-0.015,0.025] m, force noise >=0.2 N, at least two independently verified other supports. These affect reward allowance only.
candidate_scope.capture_settle_window_origin: Existing stage_task_spec.transfer_roles.window_s = 0.5; real placement event tick/120 is used, not reward-instance elapsed time or a success timer.
candidate_scope.no_hidden_motion_requirement: Earned same-attempt Q/current active_attempt and usable present geometry/contact; no additional derivative/command-change gate.

physical_field_sources.current_legs: TaskEvaluator current_legs: active_attempt, current_lift_valid, motion_continuation_allowed, air, ground_contact, obstacle_pair_active, top_contact, top_surface_contact, top_geometry, within_lateral_span, within_top_xy, front_distance_m, clearance_m, support, bearing_verified, bearing_force_n
physical_field_sources.global_evidence: VERIFIED or CONTACT_BEARING_UNVERIFIED only; the latter is not global permission and still needs all per-leg conditions. UNVERIFIED_SENSOR/NONFINITE rejected.
physical_field_sources.normalized_load: Not consumed as bearing. A consistent fixture sets an unrelated fourth leg bearing classification unknown, all normalized fractions invalid, and global CONTACT_BEARING_UNVERIFIED while two actual other supports stay verified.

verification.method: CPU-only process imports candidate semantic_reward.py under its package name; original test helpers and existing role-reward tests run against that candidate. Production files untouched.
covered: stationary earned carry all four legs
current RR EDGE vs stale lift
unknown normalized load vs missing true support
real placement event 0.5 s linear exit
original f=1 full reward result exact equality

interpretation_limits: This is an unapplied consumer/config proposal with CPU regression evidence, not a learned checkpoint evaluation.
The original transfer fraction is preserved as a lower bound; failing new carry eligibility does not change old reward behavior.
Recorded C0 already had original f=1, so this patch gives exactly the same reward there and does not explain RR collapse.
No Isaac run, optimizer update, checkpoint load, physical configuration change or task success claim was performed for this subtask.
